text: I've been trying to get through for nearly an hour now and kept getting cut off so I'm just going to put it all here. My daughter is 6 and she's had a temperature today, it was 38.4 when I checked about half an hour ago. She's also had runny poo, been to the toilet about four times since this afternoon. She is drinking well, I've been keeping on at her with water and squash and she's having it fine, and she's weeing normally too, I've been keeping an eye on that because I know you always ask. I just want to know if there's anything else I should be doing or if I just carry on like this overnight, because honestly it's very frustrating not being able to speak to anyone when you're worried about your child and the website just tells you to ring the number which nobody answers.
